bibleState.opening_disturbance: A letter reaches the family saying that Ivo's grandmother did not die in the mill fire forty years ago but was taken over the border afterwards.
bibleState.driving_goal: Find the grandmother and meet her while she is still alive.
complications: Ivo's mother burns the letter and forbids the search.
The border office holds no record under the family name.

bibleState.climax: At a care home over the border Ivo is told his grandmother will not see him, and he chooses to wait in the corridor until the home closes.
bibleState.resolution: Ivo goes home without having met her, carrying the reply she finally writes, and gives it to his mother unopened.
